offence_note: Two sexual assaults, child pornography, disobeying court order; dangerous offender
sentence_quote: The appellant appeals from the finding by Carr J. that the appellant is a dangerous offender and from the sentence of indeterminate detention.
The appellant pleaded guilty to seven offences and received a global sentence of 29 months in addition to pre-sentence custody pursuant to a joint submission.
note: Offences not named; 29 months is in addition to pre-sentence custody; Gladue not before sentencing judge

offence_note: Home invasion: break and enter, aggravated assault, robbery, confinement, stolen property
sentence_quote: on Count 1, the break and enter, I impose a sentence of 10 years minus a total of two years, two months as credit for time spent in custody, for a net sentence of seven years, 10 months.
note: Concurrent terms on other counts; co-accused Smith sentenced separately to 10 years

offence_note: Two counts of sexual assault on adult women
sentence_quote: He was sentenced to concurrent sentences of nine months’ imprisonment, followed by two-year probationary terms.

offence_note: Aggravated assault and assault with a weapon (knife)
sentence_quote: the trial judge imposed a sentence of two years less a day in custody – 23 months less one day for aggravated assault on one complainant and one month consecutive for assault with a weapon on a second complainant.
systemic_quote: ultimately concluded that a reformatory sentence should be imposed even though he thought that a penitentiary sentence would otherwise have been necessary for a non-aboriginal offender.
note: Only sentence for first complainant appealed

offence_note: Conspiracy to commit robbery and armed home invasion robbery
sentence_quote: The sentencing judge imposed a sentence of seven years less credit of 15 months for time spent in pre-sentence custody.
note: Four-year mandatory minimum applied; guilty plea mentioned but not described as mitigating

offence_note: Assaults and knife threats against wife and children
sentence_quote: The overall result is a 60-day sentence ordered to be served intermittently, together with two years’ probation.
note: Seven convictions set aside with new trials possible; sentence reduced from 90 to 60 days as a result

offence_note: Fraudulent computer use, theft of source code, possession of stolen goods
sentence_quote: The trial judge imposed a sentence of 30 months’ imprisonment.
note: Trial judge reduced sentence from 33 to 30 months for delay

offence_note: Sexual assault of university student in dormitory
sentence_quote: The appellant was convicted of sexual assault and sentenced to 18 months in jail.
note: Court refers to many strongly mitigating factors, youthful first offender

offence_note: Trafficking cocaine, fentanyl, meth; loaded handgun; proceeds of crime; breaches
sentence_quote: In total, he was sentenced to twelve years imprisonment, less one-year credit for time served.
systemic_quote: I do take that into account to the extent that I can, in particular the systemic issues that may have affected [the appellant’s] family and [the appellant] himself.
note: Only concurrent proceeds-of-crime terms reduced to 18 months; total unchanged

sentence_quote: the appellant submits that a sentence of two years is excessive having regard to the racial slur.
note: Sentence already served; complainant made racial slur at accused; egregious record

sentence_quote: He also appeals his five-year sentence (going forward) for trafficking in cocaine
note: Joint submission; concurrent 1 year and 18 months; unspecified related orders; five years going forward
